title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.structure: Likely a microstructure with phases influenced by sintering temperature
recollection.mechanism: Diffusion and phase formation during sintering
recollection.results: Possibly changes in density, hardness, and mechanical properties with temperature

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies temperature-dependent sintering, microstructural phase changes, and diffusion. It misses SPS at the optimal 1000 °C, the dense microstructure and specific oxide barrier phases, the passive-film/corrosion and parabolic oxidation mechanisms, and all reported numerical results.
